subject: [PATCH v2 1/2] mm/huge_memory: do not touch frozen folios in deferred_split_isolate()

2026-08-31.patch_summary: This patch prevents the Linux kernel from attempting to split a frozen folio in memory, which can lead to unnecessary unqueuing of the folio and incorrect handling of its partially mapped state. The patch achieves this by skipping frozen folios in the deferred_split_isolate function, allowing the owner of the folio (who has frozen it) to handle its fate instead. This change ensures that folios are not unnecessarily removed from the queue and that their partially mapped status is correctly maintained.
